title: claude-broker base status envelope
description: Progress or lifecycle update. A status with body.handoff_notes rewinds the sender's inbox cursor so a replacement session resumes the task (see CLAUDE.md invariants).

task_id.description: Unique task key. Namespaces constrain the format via a manifest extension (e.g. cb-YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>).

to.description: Addressee: a worker name, 'orchestrator', or '*' for broadcast.

subject.description: Headline, readable in the summary projection.

body.description: Status payload. body.handoff_notes (object {done, pending, files_touched, next_step}, or free text in older sessions) triggers the cursor rewind.

refs.description: Message ids, task_ids, commit shas, URLs.
